answer: Require each agent to stake 500 POA locked for 30 days before it can earn, with a ferrous-strength bond slashed 25% on a failed attestation. A farm is caught when 40 identities share one funding wallet and post identical answers within the same hour, like a reef of look-alike corals fed from one current. Detection flags any cluster above 15 accounts funded from the same source in 24 hours, and the lotus test forces each agent to complete a time-stamped task a script farm cannot batch. Attacker cost then exceeds 500 tokens per identity plus locked capital.
